title: FBI-UAP-D020, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-5, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement produced by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 sighting near a sensitive national security site.

incidents.summary: A formation of five lights, including four red points and one larger yellow-white circular object, observed over a mountain range in the western United States.
incidents.quote: Positioned horizontally above the mountain peaks are five lights: four small, distinct red points of light followed by a larger, bright yellow-white circular object
